violations.title: Receiving Temperature, Refrigerated Foods
violations.observation: The following refrigerated food item(s) is received at inadequate temperatures:Observed cut cabbage received at 45F.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated time/temperature control for safety food shall be at a temperature of 41F or below when received.Within 2 hours the cabbage had cooled to 43F. Please monitor the temperature and discard if not at 41F within the next hour and a half.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch:Observed measuring cups and knife, with cleaned utensils, with food debris dried on their surface.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized.Utensils taken to be washed,rinsed and sanitized.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device:Observed milk at 47F, half and half at 46, ham at 46F in the Beverage Air glass door refrigerator #22
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth.All TCS food discarded from the refrigerator

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed ROP salmon thawed in the ROP packages.
violations.corrective_action: All fish was removed from the ROP packages.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: Beverage Air #22 was holding at 46F and the TCS food inside was at 46F-47F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Durable Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not resistant to corrosion:Observed a knife with a decorative pattern printed on the blade that was partially worn off.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be resistant to pitting, chipping, crazing, scratching, scoring, distortion, and decomposition.CFM discontinued use of the knife.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Refuse Areas & Enclosures Maintained Clean
violations.observation: Observed a build up of grease on the surface of the ground at the base of the used oil container.
violations.corrective_action: A storage area and enclosure for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be maintained free of unnecessary items and kept clean.Discussed with CFM to have the area cleaned of residual grease.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the wall/floor juncture behind the cookline is in need of cleaning, mold build up in the dishmachine area on the ceiling and behind the dishmachine, caulking at the dump sink of the assisted living kitchen needs to be cleaned and/or recaulked.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.Discussed with the CFM the areas of cleaning/recaulking that are needed.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: MAXIMUM HOT WATER AT HANDSINK LOCATED IN MEMORY CARE KITCHEN WAS OBSERVED AT 77F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. CFM WILL CONTACT MAINTENANCE TO ADJUST HOT WATER TEMPERATURE. CFM STATED THAT THERE WAS A BUILDING ISSUE WITH HOT WATER AND MAINTENANCE ACTIVELY WORKING ON ISSUE.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: SAUSAGE IN MEMORY CARE OBSERVED AT 68F, SAUSAGE IN ASSISTED LIVING OBSERVED AT 87F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CFM DISCARDED SAUSAGE FROM BOTH AREAS. IF FOOD IS LEFT FOR EMPLOYEES, FOOD MUST BE MARKED AS SUCH.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The hot water at the hand sink in the memory care kitchen was observed at 86F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. Engineer adjusted mixing valve and hot water observed at 100F.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. Observed hand sink at main entrance of front kitchen with automatic paper dispenser batteries not functioning.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CFM provided paper towels.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the quaternary ammonium compound-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the SANITIZER BUCKET with a concentration of <200ppm total quaternary ammonium compound.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. CFM had employee remake sanitizer solution.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: sausage at 124F in steam well in assisted living kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CFM discarded sausage.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: half and half in carafe at assisted living kitchenette.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded half and half.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed thawed salmon with intact packaging in #4 and #9.
violations.corrective_action: CFM had employee cut ROP bags of salmon.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: REF/FRZ IN MAIN LOBBY KITCHENETTE.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. CFM PLACED THERMOMETER IN UNIT. BRIGHTVIEW FAIR OAKS (Inspection Date: 07/16/2025) Page 3 of 4

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: squeeze bottles with oils and sauces at prep station in main kitchen and assisted living kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM will label squeeze bottles.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Eliminate Harborage Conditions
violations.observation: Observed fruit flies in main kitchen and assisted living kitchen. Observed accumulation of water on floor around main kitchen hot water sanitizing dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. Eliminate harborage conditions to control and prevent the presence of pests on the premises. EHS recommended clearing water from floor. Establishment’s most recent pest control visit was last week and fruit flies were treated. EHS recommends additional service for fruit flies.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: type II ventilation hood at hot water sanitizing dish machine in main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. CFM had engineer reset fan. EHS recommended ensuring fan is functioning properly before using hot water sanitizing dish machine.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed ceiling tile above main kitchen hot water sanitizing dish machine with accumulation of dust and mold-like substance. Observed grout between tiles at floor around hot sanitizing dish machine with mold- like substance. Observed caulking behind 3 compartment sink with accumulation of mold-like substance.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. CFM will have ceiling tile, floor and caulking cleaned or replaced.
